# möbius for macOS 0.2.9

- Opening möbius replaces an older gateway that is still running on this Mac, as it did
  before 0.2.8. 0.2.8 could not check an older running gateway's version and showed
  "Gateway closed during version authentication" instead of replacing it.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later, and gateway 0.15.55.
